column1: # Venus Lighthouse Aerie: Felix's decision, the beacon's awakening, the second battle and fusion.

column3: {actor_name:7}{pause_20_skippable}, come with us.\nWe can take you home.{end_wait}
{actor_name:5}! What do you\nthink you're doing?{end_wait}
I won't leave\n{actor_name:7} behind.{end_wait}
What!?{pause_20_skippable} We just risked\nour lives for you!{end_wait}
I never asked you\nto fight for me.{end_wait}
{actor_name:5}, you can\nleave now. Nobody\nwill stop you.{end_wait}
Then why stay here?{end_wait}
The other beacons\nmust still be lit.{end_wait}
After all this...\nyou'll continue?{end_wait}
I know you won't\naccept that.{pause_20_skippable}\nBut{pause_20_skippable} I cannot turn back.{end_wait}
He'll light them all.\nDo we have to stop\nhim too?{end_now}
Do as you must, {actor_name:1},{pause_20_skippable}\nbut I won't give up\nmy purpose.{end_wait}
I can't hand {actor_name:7}\nover while she's\nstill in danger.{end_wait}
You think{pause_20_skippable} you've\nbeaten us for good?{pause_20_skippable}{end_wait}
They can barely stand.\nHow can they fight?{end_wait}
For now,{pause_20_skippable} yes.{pause_20_skippable}\nBut it isn't over.{page_break}The beacon still waits{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nand we must reach it.{end_wait}
No!{pause_20_skippable} The Venus Star\nwent into the\nlighthouse!{end_wait}
The beacon...\nWe're too late.{end_wait}
Look. The light...{end_wait}
My strength is\nreturning. I can\nfeel it!{end_wait}
Do you know why\nVenus restores\ntheir Fire Psynergy?{end_now}
Then explain it later.\nThey're growing stronger!{end_wait}
Neither do I.{page_break}Venus is Earth. Why\nis Fire growing stronger?{end_wait}
Earth feeds fire.{pause_20_skippable}\nYou had forgotten?{end_wait}
I feel it! My power\nis returning!{end_wait}
We can't let them\nrecover!{end_wait}
You won one fight...{end_wait}
But{pause_20_skippable} now you face\nthe strength of the\nnorthern Fire Clan!{end_wait}
The Fire Clan?{end_wait}
Our people have\nendured too much\nfor us to fail!{end_wait}
Whatever your cause,\nwe won't let you\nhurt anyone else!{end_wait}
{actor_name:5}, leave! Get\n{actor_name:7} to safety!{end_wait}
You're letting me go?{pause_20_skippable}{end_wait}
The beacon is lit.\nWe can't promise\n{actor_name:7}'s safety now.{end_wait}
Take {actor_name:7} to\nthe ship. Keep\nher safe.{end_wait}
Go! Don't waste it.{end_wait}
I won't abandon\nyou now.{end_wait}
Is it {actor_name:1}?\nIs that why you hesitate?{end_wait}
You still can't bear\nto face your friend?{end_wait}
What do you mean?{end_wait}
Your oldest friend.\nWould you stand here\nand watch him die?{end_wait}
That isn't what\nthis is about.{end_wait}
You'd shield him\nif he fell. We know.{end_wait}
Do you think I{pause_20_skippable}\nwould betray you\nfor him?{end_wait}
We cannot know what\nyou'll do when it\ncomes to that.{end_wait}
Saturos{pause_20_skippable} do you\ndoubt me too?{end_wait}
I want to trust you.{pause_20_skippable}\nBut I can't risk\neverything on it.{end_wait}
Enough. I'll take\n{actor_name:7} away myself.\nDon't try to stop me!{end_wait}
Come on,{pause_20_skippable} {actor_name:7}!{end_wait}
{actor_name:5}, wait!\nWe need to talk!{end_wait}
{actor_name:5} is no longer\nyour concern.{end_wait}
Their bodies{em_dash}{pause_20_skippable}\nthey're changing!{end_wait}
Now you'll see{pause_20_skippable}\nwhat the Fire Clan\ncan do!{end_wait}
Their Psynergy is\nsurging!{end_wait}
No escape now!{pause_20_skippable}\nNot from this!{end_wait}
They're becoming\none...{end_wait}
Everyone, get back!\nNow!{end_wait}
How...{pause_20_skippable} How could\nwe be defeated?{end_wait}
We had the power...{pause_20_skippable}\nHow did they beat us?{end_wait}
They're down.\nWe survived.{end_wait}
We defeated them...{pause_20_skippable}\nbut did we truly win?{end_now}
But the beacon\nis still burning.{end_wait}
We came to stop it.\nWe couldn't.{end_wait}
What are you saying?{end_wait}
